verses.sanskrit:
नारद उवाच।
              इदं रसातलं नाम सप्तमं पृथिवीतलम्। यत्रास्ते सुरभिर्माता गवाममृतसंभवा ॥१॥
verses.english: Narada said The name of this (region) is Rasatala which is the seventh region in the nether regions of the earth, where lives Surabhi, the mother of cows, who was born out of nectar.

verses.sanskrit: क्षरन्ती सततं क्षीरं पृथिवीसारसंभवम्। षण्णां रसानां सारेण रसमेकमनुत्तमम् ॥२॥
verses.english: She always distills milk which is produced from the essence of earthly things-which is of the one taste, having nothing superior to it, constituted of the essence of the six different tastes.
Surabhi, having no defect, herself rose from the mouth of the Grandfather, who satiated with nectar, was in days of old, vomiting the essence of all things.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याः क्षीरस्य धाराया निपतन्त्या महीतले। ह्रदः कृतः क्षीरनिधिः पवित्रं परमुच्यते ॥४॥
verses.english: One stream, even of whose milk, having fallen on the face of the earth made a lake which is called the excellent and holy sea-milk.
verses.bhavadeepa: वदनात् मुखादुदतिष्ठत् तेन मुखजेन ब्राह्मणेन तस्या एककुलत्वं यथोक्तं- ‘ब्राह्मणाश्चैव गावश्च कुलमेकं द्विधा कृतम्’ इति ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पितस्येव फेनेन पर्यन्तमनुवेष्टितम्। पिबन्तो निवसन्त्यत्र फेनपा मुनिसत्तमाः ॥५॥
verses.english: The limit of the sea is surrounded by foam which looks like flowers and here live those best among Munis-the drinkers of foam, drinking it.

verses.sanskrit: फेनपा नाम ते ख्याताः फेनाहाराश्च मातले। उग्रे तपसि वर्तन्ते येषां बिभ्यति देवताः ॥६॥
verses.english: They are known as drinkers of foam, O Matali, who practice austere asceticism and of whom the gods are afraid.
verses.bhavadeepa: फेनेन पुष्पितस्येव श्वेतस्यास्य पर्यन्तं तीरप्रदेशं फेनेनैवानुवेष्टितं पिबन्तः सादरमवलोकयन्त एव वसन्ति तेनैव फेनपा इत्युच्यन्ते ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: अस्याश्चतस्रो धेन्वोऽन्या दिक्षु सर्वासु मातले। निवसन्ति दिशां पाल्यो धारयन्तो दिशः स्म ताः ॥७॥
verses.english: She has got four calves, O Matali which are in the several cardinal points for they bear the load of these points.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वां दिशं धारयते सुरूपा नाम सौरभी। दक्षिणां हंसिका नाम धारयत्यपरां दिशम् ॥८॥
verses.english: The child of Surabhi, named Surupa supports the eastern point and the one named Hansika supports another point-the south.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमा वारुणी दिक्च धार्यते वै सुमद्र‌या। महानुभावया नित्यं मातले विश्वरूपया ॥९॥
verses.english: The western point, under the protection of Varuna, is supported by Subhadra who is ever of a great nature and of a universal foam.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामदुघा नाम धेनुर्धारयते दिशम्। उत्तरां मातले धर्म्यां तथैलविलसंज्ञिताम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: The cow, named Sarvakamadugha, supports another point, O Matali, which is the direction in which virtue rules and so named after Kubera the God of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: आसां तु पयसा मिश्रं पयो निर्मथ्य सागरे। मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा देवैरसुरसंहितैः ॥११॥
verses.english: The gods united with the Asuras, having churned the water of the ocean, mixed with milk, making the Mandara (mountain) their churning rod, extracted the Varuni wine, Lakshmi (the goddess of beauty and wealth) and nectar, O Matali and also the best of horses, Uchchaishrava and that gem Kaustubha.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृता वारुणी लक्ष्मीरमृतं चापि मातले। उच्चैःश्रवाश्चाश्वराजो मणिरत्नं च कौस्तुभम् ॥१२॥
सुधाहारेषु च सुधां स्वधाभोजिषु च स्वधाम्। अमृतं चामृताशेषु सुरभी क्षरते पयः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Surabhi yields milk that is Sudha to those that live on Sudha and Svadha to those who subsist on Svadha and Amrita to those who feed on Amrita.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता रसातलनिवासिभिः। पौराणी श्रूयते लोके गीयते या मनीषिभिः ॥१४॥
verses.english: The song, that was sung here in days of old by the inhabitants of Rasatala, is still heard to be sung in this world by wise men.
verses.bhavadeepa: सुधेति । सर्पपितृदेवानां तत्तद्योग्याहाररूपं पयः क्षरतीत्यर्थः । सुधा सर्पस्य भोजनं स्वधाभोजिनः पितरः । अमृताशेषु देवेषु ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: न नागलोके न स्वर्गे न विमाने त्रिविष्टपे। परिवासः सुखस्तादृक् रसातलतले यथा ॥१५॥
verses.english: "Neither in the region of the Nagas, nor in Svarga, nor in Vimana, nor in Trivistapa (all names for heaven) is residence so happy as in the nether regions."
